revision_summary: One minor timestamp inconsistency to fix: the button-up/conditional_booking quote 'So you could do a phone call. Could you do one tomorrow?' is correctly transcribed but Stage 3 tags it at 06:16 in cherry_pick_moments while citing the same line at 06:11 elsewhere (trajectory_verdict.grounded_examples, script_coverage). Standardize to 06:11 throughout. Additionally: (1) correct schema_reference for the 03:49 'prior_contact_probe_miss' moment — protocols.excessive_contact_complaint is an unpopulated TBD placeholder, not an active schema protocol; cite it as a schema gap or point to lead_types_and_bill_collection_rules instead. (2) Reconcile the two differing framings of the 03:56 personal-number moment (rep_intent calls it reactive, cherry_pick_moments calls it a strategic micro_trade candidate) into one coherent read. (3) Soften the causal claim linking the thin intro at 00:06 to the skepticism at 03:01 — the transcript shows the skepticism triggered by the unexplained scheduling/bill-photo ask, not the intro. (4) Flag the pervasive apparent diarization errors (customer turns mislabeled as 'rep' in short utterances like 00:11, 00:16-00:35, 01:16-01:24, 04:19-04:56) as a transcript-quality caveat, since several state-change and rep-intent reasoning chains rest on turns that may be misattributed. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read, scope-creep findings, bill-anchor audit, and booked-outcome classification are well-grounded and should be preserved.
